yamlCheck.dateAnchor: Month/day anchors March 10, 12, 15 and 17 are spoken; March 13, 14, 16 and 18 follow from next-day and third-day narration. The year 1749 comes from YAML. The fight ends at 2 a.m.; assigning its civil date March 10 follows the subsequent waking date, while a March 9 night-label convention remains possible.
yamlCheck.explanation: Current party play securely spans March 10 waking through March 18 approach (eight date transitions). The opening 2 a.m. fight and the undated earlier Tollen actions prevent an exact determination of the covered start. The hunter’s separate earlier pursuit is not extra party travel. YAML’s March 9 start may use the preceding night label; it is not used to invent an additional day. The March 12 “last night” reference also remains qualified rather than silently replacing the explicit dates.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: Opening night naming and retrospectively resolved Tollen actions leave the adventure start open.

alternatives.reading: Fight at 2 a.m. on the same civil date as the subsequent March 10 waking.
March 9 labels the preceding evening/night as in YAML, without establishing a March 9 civil clock for the fight.
Earlier Tollen contacts and nightmare attempts extend the covered events before departure, but their first date is not stated.
